title: VPN & remote access
blurb: VPN won't connect, remote desktop, working from home.

remedies.title: VPN won't connect
remedies.why: No internet first, a wrong or expired password/MFA, the clock is off, or the network (hotel, café) blocks VPNs.

steps.text: Check the internet works without the VPN (open any website).
Re-enter your password, and approve the MFA prompt quickly; many VPNs time out after a minute.
Quit the VPN app completely and reopen it; restart the computer if it still fails.
Try a different network (phone hotspot); some guest Wi-Fi blocks VPNs.

remedies.escalate: Give IT the VPN app's exact error and the time; they can check its logs.

remedies.title: VPN connected but work sites or drives don't open
symptoms: shared drive not working on vpn
remedies.why: Names of work servers aren't resolved through the VPN, or your account lacks access to that resource.

steps.text: Try the server's full name (server.company.local) or ask IT for its address.
Turn off other VPNs or privacy tools; two VPNs fight.

remedies.escalate: Tell IT which site or drive, and whether coworkers on VPN can reach it.

remedies.title: Remote Desktop won't connect to my work computer
remedies.why: The VPN isn't connected, the remote computer is asleep or off, or the name/address is wrong.

steps.text: Connect the VPN first if your work requires it.
Make sure the office computer is on and not asleep (ask someone on site, or use your company's wake tool).
Use the full computer name IT gave you.
Use the Windows App (formerly Microsoft Remote Desktop) on the Mac.

remedies.escalate: IT can check whether remote access is allowed for your account and computer.

remedies.title: IT asked me to start a remote support session
remedies.why: Built-in tools let someone you trust see your screen and help.

steps.text: Only accept sessions you asked for, from people you know at your IT team.
Windows: open Quick Assist (Start › Quick Assist) and enter the code IT gives you.
Mac: use the tool IT names; it needs Screen Recording and Accessibility permission.
End the session yourself when done.
